entry.codeblock: # Alarm Management Alarm Management provides tools for creating, monitoring, and managing alarms. ## Alarm Notifier Alarm Notifier controls how alarm notifications are delivered to users and external systems. ### Notification Channels Alarm notifications can be delivered through email, SMS, and webhook integrations. ### Notification Templates Templates define the message format used when alarm notifications are sent.

section.p: Result: The converter correctly preserves the intended hierarchy. Heading 1 becomes the topic , Heading 2 becomes the section <title>, and Heading 3 becomes a <p> tag.
